scope: Independent adversarial review of the root primal rational-content note and its existing finite-control binding. No old controls rerun.
findings: Rational content of a good squarefree ideal is unique: a split rational prime requires both prime ideals, and an inert rational prime contributes its prime ideal of squared norm. The factor c(wx)=1 is essential because w and x could otherwise complete a conjugate pair. With that condition and coprimality to (q), c(z)=q and z determines its unique eligible decomposition.

The two projectors retain v and w good squarefree, mutually coprime and prime to d before stripping. The v support condition is r divides q, not Nv divides q, including inert and double split factors. The residual y excludes v,w,d. It may still overlap q or the first residual at other primes on the enlarged rectangle, where the full original Möbius sum supplies cancellation.
The sign product is mu(w)^3 mu(v)^2 mu(z) mu(y), giving the stated mu(w) mu(z) mu(y). Literal multiplicativity leaves psi(v) psi(w)^2 with both raw zeros, and the rational factor is not neutralized.

The first mass estimate follows from counting each eligible x at length at most 7 L1/(Nw q^2). A bound below one is empty. At fixed r, summing (r j)^-2 over j >= B/r costs 1/(r max(B,r)). The second mass is at true length L2/(Nw Nv). Every nonempty shortened subunit array is bounded below by 1/7.

After the positive row comparisons Nv >= r and multiplicity at most 3^omega(r) give B^-1/2 times a harmonic r prefix and a convergent r^-3/2 tail. The w sum is harmonic. Empty terms are only enlarged positively, and the conditional pure exponents follow.

The cutoff coefficient for the full-frequency correction is frequency independent, row independent and divisor bounded after ordered splits. The original equality compensation therefore retains the elementary R/E bound without the B^-1/2 gain. The 7Li cap is only for nonzero primal terms and is not introduced into the compensated equality projection.

The existing v2 harness constructs distinct literal split and inert residue fields, exact rational content and physical norms, including a live subunit case. It compares the original complete pairs to the two-projector arrays, keeps the d row mask, and its negative controls actually detect removing psi(v) or replacing r divides q by Nv divides q. The receipt's source SHA bindings match.
limitation: Acceptance is for this full-frequency selected rational-content sector. No bound on small content, selected dual modes or the whole signed form follows.
